answer: ring-VRF nullifiers gate epoch seats: each identity derives one nullifier from a 64-member ring signature; duplicates rejected within an epoch. A farm spinning 1000 clones must hold 1000 distinct ring keys and run 1000 signings plus 64-member verification each, costing ~$9,000 in custody and compute. No bulk shortcut: nullifiers are non-deterministic per key and epoch, so reusing one key across clones emits identical nullifiers rejected. Detected clusters forfeit bonds, face 15-epoch exclusion plus key blacklist. Like a falcon threading a vertex through fog, fraud leaves a trace.
